strings.en: Whew. Feels like ages since I was last back here.
Then again, of the Far East Branch members, the only ones here now
are the two of us and the Commander.
Yeah. The Cyber Beast Force is in space,
and Chris and the others are in that place called Byston Well...
Are Big Bro and the others really in that Byston Well place?
That's what they said was most likely, but...
Will Joe and the others truly be able to come back...?
Even if that guy never came back, it'd be no trouble for us.
It may be no trouble for you, but it would be for me...!
M-My apologies... Princess...
Princess... raising your voice like that...
Right. Even if they're safe, it's no good if they can't come back.
Show came back once before. Won't it work out somehow?
Akira's right.
For now, all we can do is trust them and wait, isn't it?
Joe... please... come back...
So, how are you feeling, Daisuke?
I'm still a little numb, but I'm fine.
Don't worry. This ray gun is the real thing.
What makes you think so, Maria?
But the radiation wounds are gone from Brother's body, aren't they?
Yeah, but... it won't have weird side effects later, will it?
How can you be so sure?
But the radiation wounds are gone from Brother's body, aren't they?
But it could be rigged to make him sick later. We can't let our guard...
It's fine. She's not that kind of person.
Yes... she did seem to be being used...
The Vega Star Federation grew by invading many planets...
That girl likely can't defy their orders either...
We'll have to thank her next time we meet, Brother.
Yes, we will. By the way, Father, what should I do with this ray gun?
It may be useful for future research.
Hold on to it until you next come to the Space Science Lab.
Understood.
Who's there!!
Huh? What's wrong all of a sudden, Domon?
Come out! If you don't, I'll blow you away, pine tree and all!
Hahahaha, it is I... Domon Kasshu.
You're the one from before?
Yes... Schwarz Bruder.
The one we met at Jaburo?
What's Schwarz Bruder playing at!?
I came to stop you. I know full well where you're headed.
Where? You're going off to train, right, Domon?
Domon intends to go after Master Asia alone...
Domon...
Last time you helped me, and now you're getting in my way!?
Heed my advice. Turn back now! You cannot win!
That's none of your business! I have my own plan!
I'm telling you your master, Master Asia, has long since seen through it.
Listen, Domon Kasshu. Get as worked up as you like, you cannot win!
What!!
And your skill isn't up to it either!
Dammit...!
Domon... Schwarz is right. No matter what, you can't take on
Master Asia and the Devil Gundam alone.
Watch closely, Domon. A fist without heart creates only destruction,
yet depending on its use, that power can become something wonderful.
Yes, great power has two faces.
It is a double-edged sword. Now, which will you choose...?
Sorry to trouble you, Dr. Hazuki. Well then...
Huh, wasn't that the old guy just now?
Yes, it seems the enemy is heading for the Nanbara Connection...
Then shouldn't we hurry to the Connection?
Thing is... that's not all...
Seems Akira's missing dad is being held hostage
by the Demon Empire...
No way...
The Nanbara Connection's got its electromagnetic cannon and barrier.
Wouldn't it be better to go rescue
Akira's dad from them kidnappers first?
...No. If they took a hostage, they must want something in exchange.
My father should be safe for a while...
Akira...
Commander, what now? The Nanbara Connection's closer from here.
Hmm... It seems a decision must be made...
